data.name: Hakamun
data.gender_notes: Hakamun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is given the power to judge and make decisions based on knowledge and understanding. The name Hakamun carries the meaning “Judge, Arbiter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hakamun usually hope their child will grow to embody judge, arbiter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifying a person of great wisdom and justness, entrusted with the responsibility of making decisions for the greater good.
data.etymology: Hakamun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Judge, Arbiter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hakamun total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: حكم
in_arabic.meaning: حكم يعني القضاء والفصل بين الأشياء بحكمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: حكم هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه القضاء والفصل بين الأشياء بحكمة، ويشير إلى الحكمة والعدل في الحكم على الأمور. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُولَٰئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْئُولًا' (الإسراء:36)، وقد ذكر اسم الحكم في السنة النبوية أيضًا.

in_urdu.name: حکم
in_urdu.meaning: حکم کا مطلب ہے قضاء اور حکمت کے ساتھ فیصلہ کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: حکم ایک علم نام ہے جو عربی اصل سے ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے قضاء اور حکمت کے ساتھ فیصلہ کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ حکمت، انصاف اور سچائی کی صفات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हकम
in_hindi.meaning: हकम का अर्थ है न्याय और ज्ञान के साथ निर्णय लेना
in_hindi.long_meaning: हकम एक नाम है जो अरबी मूल से है और इसका अर्थ है न्याय और ज्ञान के साथ निर्णय लेना। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह ज्ञान, न्याय और सच्चाई के गुणों को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: حکم
in_pashto.meaning: حکم د قضاوت او پریکړې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: حکم د علم نوم دی چي د عربي اصلي څخه يي اخيستل شوي او د قضاوت او پریکړې معنی لري. دا نوم د افغانستان په اسلامی کیلنڈر کی ډیر اهمیت لری ځکه چی دا د حکمت، انصاف او صداقت صفات ښيي.

in_english.name: Hakamun
in_english.meaning: Hakamun means wise ruler or one who judges with justice
in_english.long_meaning: Hakamun is derived from the Arabic root 'h-k-m,' which means 'to judge' or 'to rule wisely.' It signifies a person who possesses wisdom, justice, and fairness in their judgments and decisions. In Islamic tradition, the name Hakamun reflects the attributes of a wise and just leader, echoing the Quranic emphasis on justice and righteous governance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hakamun holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic society, particularly in its legal and judicial aspects. In Islamic law, a Hakam (plural Hukkam or Hakamun) is an expert or judge, who is responsible for interpreting and applying religious and secular laws based on his extensive knowledge of Islamic jurisprudence. The figure of a Hakam holds a powerful position within the community as they are entrusted with resolving legal disputes and providing guidance to those seeking advice.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hakamun carries the connotation of wisdom, justice and knowledge. The ability to judge and make decisions with clarity and understanding highlights the importance of seeking knowledge and gaining wisdom in Islamic teachings. Moreover, being a Hakam involves being a trusted adviser and guide to others, emphasizing the importance of compassion, empathy, and fairness in Islamic ethics. Ultimately, the name Hakamun reflects the Islamic values of justice, wisdom, and knowledge, underscoring the spiritual significance of making informed and fair decisions.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Judge, Arbiter" symbolizes One who is given the power to judge and make decisions based on knowledge and understanding.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Hakamun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of judge, arbiter.
